title: Debounce the rename field's autosave
prompt: EditableTitle saves on every keystroke. Debounce it with a setTimeout handle in a ref: commit once after the user stops typing, immediately on blur, and never after unmount.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing does not call onCommit while the user is still typing
Exactly one onCommit fires with the final value once typing stops for SAVE_DELAY_MS
Blur commits immediately (once) and cancels the pending timer; blur without an edit commits nothing
The same value is never committed twice — a blur after a completed autosave is a no-op, while a fresh edit still commits
